items.html: *Behold, it was said above that the lights of the NHY of Bina herself, which were the aspect of blood below, in her Yesod, rose upward at the time of birth; and through their ascent from below upward, to the place of the chest, they were sweetened, for behold, they were turned into milk, and from there the fetus is nourished. Also those two upper joints of the NH of Arich, which rose into the chest of Ima and remained there always, in the secret of breasts and nipples — behold, the NHY are the secret of judgments, for therefore they are outside the body, as is known; and when they rise upward, to the place of HGT, they are sweetened and turned into milk, which is mercy.
